hypothesis: Inverse-frequency-weighted word and character overlap will select more useful references than injecting the entire memory, raising aggregate macro accuracy above the 63.3% fewshot_all result while reducing average context length; either failure falsifies the claim.

Explicitly stating that the current problem controls answer serialization, while labeling demonstrations as reference target values, will raise pooled macro accuracy above 63.3%; evaluation at or below that aggregate result falsifies the claim.

Storing incorrect attempts beside their corrected targets and presenting those pairs as warnings will improve aggregate macro accuracy over the 63.3% fewshot_all baseline with a compact context; evaluation that fails either outcome falsifies the claim.

The 66.7% instruction-anchored result exceeded the 60.0% retrieval result, suggesting broad labeled coverage helps; compacting near-duplicate same-answer items and round-robin selection across distinct answers will exceed 66.7% while keeping reference context below 12,000 characters.

The 60.0% lexical retrieval result may improve when query features from the latest headed content section receive more weight and redundant references are penalized; this candidate should exceed 60.0% at a similar context length.

Error-contrast memory scored 50.0%, below systems using ordinary labeled references; learning close, differently labeled pairs from ground-truth examples rather than failed predictions should exceed 50.0% by making relevant distinctions explicit.

Restating concise output-format cues verbatim from the live problem after its references will improve aggregate accuracy over instruction_anchored_memory by reducing answer-wrapper and serialization errors.

When a query and stored examples share exact template lines, removing those lines pairwise before ranking and presenting references will improve aggregate accuracy over retrieval_weighted_examples by exposing problem-specific evidence.
Using was_correct feedback linked to the selected references to adjust their future retrieval weights will improve aggregate accuracy over retrieval_weighted_examples.

Among similarly relevant references, modestly discounting repeated answer patterns will improve aggregate accuracy by exposing more distinct evidence; this is falsified if accuracy does not exceed fixed top-k retrieval.

Retrieving on variable problem spans rather than repeated prompt wording will improve aggregate accuracy at comparable context length; this is falsified if span-based retrieval fails to outperform full-input retrieval.

Using fewer references for a strong, well-separated nearest match and broadening retrieval when matches are weak or ambiguous will improve the accuracy-context tradeoff; this is falsified if adaptive breadth does not improve aggregate Pareto performance.

Across the pooled objective, weighting lexical similarity together with generic answer-shape overlap will improve accuracy over query-diverse retrieval by surfacing demonstrations with compatible output contracts; this is falsified if accuracy does not rise or context cost rises without an accuracy gain.

Across the pooled objective, compact term profiles for recurring answers will improve accuracy over broad demonstrations by exposing repeated label evidence while using less context; this is falsified if accuracy falls or profile tokens fail to add value over nearest examples.

Across the pooled objective, selecting the most query-overlapping passages from retrieved examples will preserve useful case evidence while reducing context length and improving accuracy over full-example retrieval; this is falsified if compressed references reduce accuracy or fail to lower context cost.

Across the pooled validation traces, summarizing similarity-weighted target support among the six closest references will improve macro-average accuracy over query-diverse retrieval when nearby examples disagree, with only a modest context increase.

Across the pooled validation traces, showing prior mistakes only alongside close corrected cases and relevant successes will improve macro-average accuracy over ungated error memory by reducing the influence of unrelated corrections.

Across the pooled validation traces, factoring verbatim repeated lines out of reference examples will reduce injected context while retaining enough example-specific evidence to match or exceed instruction-anchored memory accuracy.
